question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is "**action**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given option, "**action**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.
 
• We use the word "**action**" to mean - something done or performed.
 
• Thus,** option 2 **is the correct option.

Correct Paragraph__**:** *When it (1) __comes__ to witnessing wars, famines or disease outbreaks on the news, guilt may (2) __inspire__ us to volunteer or donate money. Watching the generosity of other people (3) __who__ play an active role in helping others is also guilt-provoking, which can (4) __in__ turn activate us to take similar **(5) __action__** thus paying forward.*
